description: Source file implementing Wi-Fi telemetry link metrics management, including callback registration, link reinitialization, start/stop metrics, and link stats management.

methods.name: qmgr_register_batch_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for batch reports.

methods.name: qmgr_register_score_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for score reports.

methods.name: qmgr_is_batch_registered
methods.description: Checks if batch callback is registered.

methods.name: qmgr_is_score_registered
methods.description: Checks if score callback is registered.

methods.name: reset_qmgr_score_cb
methods.description: Resets the score callback to NULL.

methods.name: qmgr_invoke_batch
methods.description: Invokes the batch callback with the given report batch.

methods.name: qmgr_invoke_score
methods.description: Invokes the score callback with provided string, score, and threshold.

methods.name: reinit_link_metrics
methods.description: Reinitializes link metrics with specified server arguments.

methods.name: unregister_station_mac
methods.description: Unregisters a station MAC address and resets score callback.

methods.name: stop_link_metrics
methods.description: Stops link metrics collection and destroys instance.

methods.name: add_stats_metrics
methods.description: Adds statistics metrics for a given station.

methods.name: disconnect_link_stats
methods.description: Disconnects link statistics for a station.

methods.name: remove_link_stats
methods.description: Removes link statistics for a station.
